purpose: Separate the effect of a pre-only baseline initializer from previously frozen state increments. Evaluate a complete two-head ablation, not a post-result winner selection.
timing: Registered after primary5-method outcomes were viewed, before this additional calculation. Explicitly secondary/posthoc; not fresh validation or a new selected candidate.
sessions: All12, keep same development opposite-gap and already seen confirmation final slope. No refit, new window, threshold or discarded session.
policy_difference: CPU minus PAR in each role/gap block, same0..120. Prediction-minus-observed difference error. These blocks have different session initial conditions; report as recorded association, not identical-initial-condition counterfactual policy effect.
